Read the commits since the last tag and write release notes grouped by area, in the house
style, with one sentence per change.

read_each_decide.instructions: This file tells an agent to go through many items one by one and make the same closed judgement about each.

criteria.true: It instructs the agent to read each of a set of items (files, tickets, commits, failures, reviews, rows) and give each a label, a yes or no, a pick from fixed options or a score.
criteria.false: It asks the agent to do or write something for each item (fix, edit, summarise, generate), or it judges one thing only, or it gives no per-item instruction.

classify_fanout.instructions: This file dispatches subagents or parallel agent runs whose job is to classify, check or grade items.

criteria.true: It spawns, dispatches or fans out agents, one per item or partition, and each returns a verdict, label or score.
criteria.false: It dispatches no agents, or the agents it dispatches write, edit, research or generate rather than judge.

prompt_hook_verdict.instructions: This file configures a hook or gate that asks a language model for a yes or no, allow or deny, or pass or fail verdict.

criteria.true: A hook, check or gate runs a prompt through a language model (a prompt-type hook, claude -p, codex exec or an API call) and acts on a closed verdict from it.
criteria.false: Its hooks run ordinary scripts, commands or pattern matching, or it has no hooks.

fixed_rubric.instructions: This file has a step that grades work against a fixed rubric or checklist and returns a verdict.

criteria.true: A reviewer, critic, verifier or grading step checks output against listed criteria and returns pass or fail, a score or a label per criterion.
criteria.false: The review is open-ended (write feedback, suggest improvements), or there is no grading step.

iteration_cap.instructions: This file stops an agent loop after a fixed number of iterations or retries instead of checking whether it is making progress.

criteria.true: A loop, retry or repair cycle ends on a hard count ("stop after 20 tries", "at most 5 rounds") with no check of progress.
criteria.false: The loop ends when a condition is met or progress stops, or there is no loop.
